obligations.subject: S1 native object 0x40 Motobug
obligations.contract: After floor acquisition, compare pause countdown, signed walking velocity, floor following and reversal at both floor-distance limits against the original ROM. Smoke timing and damage/death remain separate, uncatalogued behavior.

reference.citation: src/main/java/com/openggf/game/sonic1/objects/badniks/Sonic1MotobugBadnikInstance.java documents Moto_Main and Moto_Action from docs/s1disasm/_incObj/40 Moto Bug.asm.

obligations.subject: S1 native object 0x44 GHZ edge wall
obligations.contract: Compare native pixels for each original mapping frame with original tile attributes and palette at an explicitly matched presentation checkpoint. Unobserved priority interactions and world contexts remain open.

reference.citation: src/main/java/com/openggf/game/sonic1/objects/Sonic1EdgeWallObjectInstance.java and CHANGELOG.0.7.prerelease.md describe original GHZ edge-wall mapping and palette ownership.

obligations.subject: S2 native object 0x41 horizontal spring
obligations.contract: Compare the unsigned x_pos launch-side contact gate with both x_flip states, both player owners and the exact equality boundary. A pushing player on the other side must not receive a launch.

obligations.subject: S2 native object 0x9D Coconuts
obligations.contract: Compare initial routine dispatch and the following idle countdown with the original ROM. Creation must not also consume the first active idle tick. Climbing, throwing, damage and child lifetime remain separate, uncatalogued behavior.

reference.citation: src/main/java/com/openggf/game/sonic2/objects/badniks/CoconutsBadnikInstance.java describes the Obj9D state machine; docs/architecture/audits/2026-10-07-s2-parity-gap-verification.md records the Coconuts initialization regression.

obligations.subject: S3KL native object 0xBF Ribot active child
obligations.contract: Compare child creation, initialization and first orbit dispatch against the original ROM. Both active-child initialization paths return before orbit, including allocation into a later slot of the same object pass.

reference.citation: docs/architecture/audits/2026-10-07-s3k-parity-gap-verification.md#confirmed-source-discrepancy-under-investigation identifies Obj_Ribot, loc_8C396, loc_8C594 and loc_8C41E.

obligations.subject: S3K Get_LevelSizeStart focus calculation

context.character: original Sonic, Tails and Knuckles routes
context.acts: DEZ1 and HPZ2; Knuckles CNZ1 and LRZ1

obligations.contract: Compare the native focus-word offset, unsigned wrap, zero/maximum saturation and checkpoint bypass with Get_LevelSizeStart. This covers the focus calculation only, not title publication, full entry flow or camera motion.

reference.citation: src/main/java/com/openggf/game/sonic3k/Sonic3kLevelStartCamera.java identifies Get_LevelSizeStart, loc_1BE46, loc_1BF48, loc_1BF70 and loc_1BF74; docs/status/level-test-coverage.md records its bounded coverage.
